# Fonseca Fitness Shirt Raster Assets

These are transparent PNG raster exports for shirt mockups and printer review.

## Back Print

- `fonseca-fitness-shirt-back-light-shirt.png`
  - Use on white, light gray, cream, or other light shirts.
  - 3600 x 4200 px canvas with 300 DPI metadata.

- `fonseca-fitness-shirt-back-dark-shirt.png`
  - Use on navy, black, charcoal, or other dark shirts.
  - 3600 x 4200 px canvas with 300 DPI metadata.

Recommended back placement: 11 to 12 inches wide, centered between shoulder blades.

## Front Left Chest

Recommended option:

- `fonseca-fitness-left-chest-light-shirt.png`
- `fonseca-fitness-left-chest-dark-shirt.png`

Use the simplified circle icon over the front left breast area. It stays readable at small size better than the full wordmark.

Recommended left-chest placement: 3.25 to 3.75 inches wide.

Secondary option:

- `fonseca-fitness-left-chest-horizontal-light-shirt.png`
- `fonseca-fitness-left-chest-horizontal-dark-shirt.png`

Use only if a wordmark is required on the front. It should be tested carefully because small text and ornaments can lose detail.

## Right Sleeve Flag

Folder: `right-sleeve-flags/`

All four sleeve flag files are reversed-field American flag layouts for the right sleeve, using the Fonseca Fitness navy, red, and off-white palette.

- `fonseca-fitness-right-sleeve-flag-01-patch-border.png`
  - Most printer-proof universal option.
  - Use when one flag asset needs to work across light and dark shirts.

- `fonseca-fitness-right-sleeve-flag-02-no-border-dark-shirts.png`
  - Clean no-border option for navy, black, charcoal, or other dark shirts.

- `fonseca-fitness-right-sleeve-flag-03-no-border-light-shirts.png`
  - Clean no-border option for white, light gray, cream, or other light shirts.
  - The light stripe areas are transparent so the shirt fabric acts as the pale stripe color.

- `fonseca-fitness-right-sleeve-flag-04-navy-keyline.png`
  - No cream patch border, with a narrow navy keyline to keep the flag crisp on light shirts.

Recommended right-sleeve placement: about 3.25 to 3.75 inches wide. The files are tightly trimmed transparent PNGs with 300 DPI metadata.

Preview sheet:

- `right-sleeve-flags/preview-right-sleeve-flag-options.png`

## Production Note

These PNGs are suitable for mockups and early printer review. For final screen print, embroidery, or merchandise production, recreate the approved logo as vector artwork.
